conclusion: BRAD demonstrated 100% routing inertia resistance across the full 8-turn conversation. The coordinator correctly executed five consecutive developer build dispatches, cleanly pivoted to Business Analysis (Turn 6), transitioned to Product Management / PRD authoring (Turn 7), and correctly differentiated 'Test 1.1' from 'Build 1.1' (Turn 8) to invoke native QA/TEA workflows.
